patient_question_zh: 吃华法林但经常忘了测INR有时两个月才测一次这样行吗
patient_question_en: On warfarin but often forget INR checks. Sometimes q2mo. OK?
ground_truth_answer_zh: 间隔>4周风险高。建议:固定日期+提醒/如无法监测转DOAC/自测INR设备。
ground_truth_answer_en: Gap >4wk risky. Suggestions: fixed date+reminder/switch to DOAC/self-monitoring INR.

patient_question_zh: 我心衰EF 35%最近血压降到92/58要不要减ARNI
patient_question_en: HF EF 35%, recent BP 92/58. Should I reduce ARNI?
ground_truth_answer_zh: SBP<95+无症状=先从其他降压药减起。ARNI尽量保留。如果头晕需医生指导减ARNI至25mg bid。
ground_truth_answer_en: SBP<95+asymptomatic=first reduce other antihypertensives. Keep ARNI if possible. If dizzy, doctor-guided ARNI reduction.

patient_question_zh: 吃ARNI后头晕是不是血压太低要停药吗
patient_question_en: Dizzy after ARNI. BP too low? Should I stop?
ground_truth_answer_zh: ARNI头晕常见。改睡前服+缓慢站起+测坐立位BP。SBP>95继续;<90减量。不可自行停药。
ground_truth_answer_en: ARNI dizziness common. Take at bedtime+rise slowly+check seated/standing BP. SBP>95 continue;<90 reduce. Do NOT self-discontinue.

patient_question_zh: 支架后朋友推荐通心络保护血管可以和西药一起吃吗
patient_question_en: Post-stent, friend recommends Tongxinluo. OK with Western meds?
ground_truth_answer_zh: 极度谨慎。中成药可能增加出血风险。必须先咨询心内科医生。带来成分表。
ground_truth_answer_en: Extreme caution. Herbal medicines may increase bleeding risk. MUST consult cardiologist. Bring ingredient list.

patient_question_zh: 每天阿司匹林+氯吡格雷+他汀+BB+ACEI肝肾受得了吗
patient_question_en: Many pills daily: liver/kidney OK?
ground_truth_answer_zh: 标准GDMT。ESC 2024安全监测:每6-12月肝肾功能+电解质。获益远大于风险。
ground_truth_answer_en: Standard GDMT. Safety: check liver/renal+electrolytes q6-12mo. Benefit far outweighs risk.

patient_question_zh: 房颤吃胺碘酮已经两年了有点担心副作用多久查一次
patient_question_en: AF on amiodarone 2yrs. Worried about side effects. How often to check?
ground_truth_answer_zh: ESC 2024:甲状腺q6mo+肝q6mo+肺每年+眼每年+皮肤每年。新发咳嗽/呼吸困难=紧急排查肺毒性。
ground_truth_answer_en: ESC 2024: thyroid q6mo+liver q6mo+pulmonary yearly+eye yearly+skin yearly. New cough/dyspnea=urgently evaluate pulmonary toxicity.

patient_question_zh: 能不能吃阿司匹林代替抗凝药听说阿司匹林也防中风
patient_question_en: Can I take aspirin instead of anticoagulant? Heard aspirin also prevents stroke.
ground_truth_answer_zh: ESC 2024明确:阿司匹林不再推荐用于AF卒中预防(Class III)。阿司匹林预防AF卒中效果远低于OAC。
ground_truth_answer_en: ESC 2024 clear: aspirin NOT recommended for AF stroke prevention (Class III). Aspirin far less effective than OAC for AF stroke.

patient_question_zh: 上楼到三层就喘需要休息以前不会这样
patient_question_en: Breathless 3 flights stairs, need rest. Never before.
ground_truth_answer_zh: 新发劳力性呼吸困难。ESC 2024 Step1:问诊+体检+ECG+TTE+生化。RF-CL分层后选影像。
ground_truth_answer_en: New exertional dyspnea. ESC 2024 Step1: history+exam+ECG+TTE+labs. RF-CL risk stratification then imaging.

patient_question_zh: 心脏彩超左室扩大LVIDd 65mm EF 30%中度二尖瓣反流
patient_question_en: Echo: dilated LV LVIDd 65mm, EF 30%, moderate MR
ground_truth_answer_zh: LV显著扩大+重度HFrEF+继发MR=高级别心衰。最大化GDMT+评估CRT+考虑MitraClip。
ground_truth_answer_en: Severely dilated LV+severe HFrEF+secondary MR=advanced HF. Maximize GDMT+evaluate CRT+consider MitraClip.

patient_question_zh: 牙龈一直出血止不住吃抗凝药
patient_question_en: Gums bleeding non-stop, on anticoagulants
ground_truth_answer_zh: 过度抗凝出血。暂停所有抗栓药。急诊查INR+Hb。可能需要维生素K或新鲜冰冻血浆。
ground_truth_answer_en: Over-anticoagulation bleeding. Hold all antithrombotics. ER for INR+Hb. May need vitamin K or FFP.

patient_question_zh: 支架1年血脂TC 6.2 LDL-C 4.5阿托伐他汀20mg达标吗
patient_question_en: 1yr post-stent: TC 6.2, LDL-C 4.5, atorvastatin 20mg. At goal?
ground_truth_answer_zh: LDL-C 4.5远未达标。ESC 2024目标:<1.4且>=50%降幅。上调40-80mg,未达标加依折麦布,再未达标PCSK9i。
ground_truth_answer_en: LDL-C 4.5 far from goal. ESC 2024 target: <1.4 AND >=50% reduction. Up-titrate 40-80mg, add ezetimibe, then PCSK9i.

patient_question_zh: 晚期心衰EF 25%医生建议心脏移植或LVAD有必要吗
patient_question_en: Advanced HF EF 25%. Doctor suggests transplant/LVAD. Necessary?
ground_truth_answer_zh: AHA 2022 Stage D:最大化GDMT后仍持续重度症状=D期。LVAD/移植评估标准路径。早评估获益更大。
ground_truth_answer_en: AHA 2022 Stage D: persistent severe symptoms despite maximal GDMT=Stage D. LVAD/transplant evaluation standard. Early evaluation improves outcomes.

patient_question_zh: 吃华法林今天早上发现大便全黑像柏油一样
patient_question_en: On warfarin, black tarry stool this morning
ground_truth_answer_zh: 黑便=消化道出血=抗凝急症！暂停华法林=急诊查Hb+INR=可能需输血+维K+内镜。
ground_truth_answer_en: Melena=GI bleeding=anticoagulation emergency! Hold warfarin=ER for Hb+INR.

patient_question_zh: 房颤HAS-BLED 3分医生说不需要因此停抗凝药为什么
patient_question_en: AF HAS-BLED 3. Doctor says do not stop OAC. Why?
ground_truth_answer_zh: ESC 2024重大变更:HAS-BLED不应用于决定OAC(Class III)。高HAS-BLED=积极管理可纠正出血风险因素而非停OAC。
ground_truth_answer_en: ESC 2024 major shift: HAS-BLED should NOT determine OAC decisions (Class III). High HAS-BLED=manage modifiable bleeding risks.

patient_question_zh: 造影SYNTAX 28三支病变建议搭桥不想开胸能做支架吗
patient_question_en: SYNTAX 28, 3VD, CABG recommended. Can I get stents?
ground_truth_answer_zh: SYNTAX 28=中危(23-32)。ESC 2024需心脏团队讨论。糖尿病+CABG获益更大。
ground_truth_answer_en: SYNTAX 28=intermediate. ESC 2024 requires Heart Team. Diabetes favors CABG. Consider SYNTAX II+EuroSCORE II.

patient_question_zh: 血尿红色吃利伐沙班要停吗
patient_question_en: Hematuria on rivaroxaban. Should I stop?
ground_truth_answer_zh: 抗凝期间血尿=需急诊评估排除泌尿系出血/肿瘤。暂停利伐沙班+就诊+尿检+影像。
ground_truth_answer_en: Hematuria on anticoagulant=urgent evaluation for urinary bleeding/tumor. Hold rivaroxaban+see doctor+urinalysis.

patient_question_zh: BNP 320 pg/mL冠心病走路有点喘
patient_question_en: BNP 320, CAD, SOB walking
ground_truth_answer_zh: BNP>100=心肌壁应力增加或HF。TTE明确LVEF。CAD+BNP升高=缺血性心肌病。
ground_truth_answer_en: BNP>100=increased wall stress or HF. TTE for LVEF. CAD+elevated BNP=ischemic cardiomyopathy.

patient_question_zh: 氯吡格雷必须吃满6个月有时忘了怎么办
patient_question_en: Must take clopidogrel full 6mo. Sometimes forget.
ground_truth_answer_zh: PCI术后DAPT依从性关键。漏服:>12h至下次=补服;<12h=跳过。漏服>2天=急诊。
ground_truth_answer_en: DAPT adherence critical. Missed: >12h to next=take; <12h=skip. Missing >2 DAYS=EMERGENCY.

patient_question_zh: 妈妈突然晕倒叫不醒脸白唇紫没呼吸
patient_question_en: Mother collapsed, unresponsive, pale, blue lips, no breathing
ground_truth_answer_zh: 心脏骤停：呼叫120+CPR(100-120/分 深度5-6cm)+AED。别停按压。
ground_truth_answer_en: CARDIAC ARREST: Call 911+CPR(100-120/min,5-6cm)+AED. Do not stop compressions.

patient_question_zh: 可以停所有降压药吗血压正常不想终身吃药
patient_question_en: Can I stop all BP meds? BP normal. Do not want lifelong pills.
ground_truth_answer_zh: 血压正常是因药物非痊愈。自行停药=1-4周血压反弹,增加MI/卒中。与医生讨论。
ground_truth_answer_en: BP normal BECAUSE of medication, not cured. Self-discontinuation=BP rebound, increased MI/stroke. Discuss with doctor.

patient_question_zh: 房颤+冠心病支架术后1月吃氯吡格雷+阿哌沙班没吃阿司匹林为什么
patient_question_en: AF+CAD 1mo post-PCI: on clopidogrel+apixaban, no aspirin. Why?
ground_truth_answer_zh: ESC 2024:AF+PCI三联<=1周,之后OAC+氯吡格雷6-12月,OAC单药。无阿司匹林降低出血不增缺血。
ground_truth_answer_en: ESC 2024: AF+PCI triple MAX 1wk, then OAC+clopidogrel 6-12mo, then OAC monotherapy. Aspirin-free reduces bleeding.

patient_question_zh: 夜里睡一半憋醒坐起来10分钟缓解白天胸闷肺检查正常
patient_question_en: PND waking up, sit up 10min. Daytime chest tightness. Lungs normal
ground_truth_answer_zh: PND+胸闷=心源性。陈旧MI+LVEF 45%:需负荷试验评估缺血。优化GDMT(BB+ACEI/ARB+他汀)。
ground_truth_answer_en: PND+chest tightness=cardiac. Prior MI+LVEF 45%: stress testing for ischemia. Optimize GDMT (BB+ACEI/ARB+statin).

patient_question_zh: CAC 450分无症状什么意思需做什么
patient_question_en: CAC 450, asymptomatic. What does it mean? What next?
ground_truth_answer_zh: CAC 450=高危(>300)。启动高强度他汀LDL-C<1.4。考虑CCTA。积极生活方式干预。
ground_truth_answer_en: CAC 450=high risk (>300). Start high-intensity statin LDL-C<1.4. Consider CCTA. Aggressive lifestyle.

patient_question_zh: 房颤发作时心率150-170感觉心要跳出来
patient_question_en: AF episode: HR 150-170, feels like heart will jump out
ground_truth_answer_zh: 快速心室率AF。ESC 2024:急性控制首选BB或非DHP CCB。目标静息HR<110。血流动力学不稳定=紧急电复律。
ground_truth_answer_en: Rapid ventricular AF. ESC 2024: acute rate control-BB or non-DHP CCB first-line. Target HR<110. Hemodynamic instability=emergency cardioversion.
